model_name: Orbital Economy v7.7.16 r1 — Cost Pricing
notes: v7.7.16: full money accounting, step 1 (owner decisions 2026-10-16) — prices of ore, power resource, energy and food at full unit cost (materials and energy through smoothed price signals, labor x wage, capital wear, rent = the old base price) x 1.15 x their scarcity factor; cost prices of capital goods, construction materials and regolith; one 15 % markup; reference prices and the price index scaled per region; one cost_pricing node, model/nodes/cost_pricing.json, switch Cost Pricing Enabled. Money stocks come next. See docs/tasks/039-cost-pricing/.
Modes 0-55 keep Cost Pricing Enabled = 0 and reproduce v7.7.15 r1 exactly; Mode 56 = Mode 52 with cost pricing, Mode 57 = Mode 53 (transport surge with the labor market) with cost pricing.
Exact numbers are defined on the canonical platform (docs/VERSIONING_AND_AUTHORITY.md section 8); series-digest.windows.json is the golden.
